$comment: Single source of truth for model routing and budget policy. Edit, then run `relay build` (regenerates agents/, codex/agents/ and the routing block in hooks/register.ts).

unrouted.$comment: Claude built-in agents that would otherwise inherit the session model (often Opus). Other plugins' agents keep their own frontmatter.

forecast.$comment: Placeholder rates until `relay calibrate` has real samples: pctPerUnit is % of the 5-hour window per weight unit, minutesPerUnit wall-clock minutes per unit. A task's weight = tierWeight[tier] × riskFactor[risk]; a lane's expected weight adds a fix round with probability fixRoundProbability[riskiest task] that re-works fixRoundCost of the lane.
